description_en: Checks whether an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL primary instance meets the prerequisites for creating a DuckDB-based analytical instance. For conditions that are not met, the operation returns the failure reasons and provides solutions or recommended target values
description_zh: 该接口用于检查RDS PostgreSQL主实例是否满足创建DuckDB分析实例的前提条件。对于不满足的条件将返回失败原因，并提供解决方案或建议的目标值
name: PrecheckDuckDBDependency

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the primary instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

FailedCheckItems.description_en: The items that do not meet the prerequisites for creating a DuckDB-based analytical instance
FailedCheckItems.description_zh: 不符合创建DuckDB分析实例的条目

AllowAutoModify.description_en:
Indicates whether the item can be fixed with one click.

true: The item can be fixed with one click by calling the [ModifyDBInstanceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html） operation.
false: The item cannot be fixed with one click.


<notice>If the major engine version of the database instance does not meet the requirements, you must perform a [manual upgrade]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html）.></notice>
AllowAutoModify.description_zh:
是否可以一键修复。

true：是。可以通过调用[ModifyDBInstanceConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html）接口一键修复。
false：否。


<notice>当数据库实例大版本不符合要求时，需要通过[手动升级]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2623684.html）。></notice>

CurrentValue.description_en: The current value of the check item

Name.description_en: The name of the check item

RequiredValue.description_en: The target value or target range of the check item
RequiredValue.description_zh: 检查项的目标值（或目标区间）

Type.description_en:
The check item type. Valid values:

Parameter: parameter.
MinorVersion: minor engine version.
MajorVersion: major engine version
Type.description_zh:
检查项。取值：

Parameter：参数。
MinorVersion：内核小版本。
MajorVersion：数据库大版本

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the prerequisite check for creating a DuckDB-based analytical instance is passed. Valid values:

true: The check is passed.
false: The check is not passed
Result.description_zh:
是否通过创建DuckDB分析实例的前置校验。取值：

true：是。
false：否
